title: feat(opp0fill): four of eight F_cut fillers silence opp2
science: Next narrowing step of the same selector chain, not a probe cell: of the 8 F_cut 1-site fillers found in #6399, exactly N_opp0=4 also satisfy f(opp2)=0 (opp2 = the size-3 axis-type (0,1,2) orbit, one fully occupied axis and four empty slots; 'a filled axis does not form'). f_L1 is one of the 4 but still not unique - f_diamond is again the explicit second witness, with lock history (1,4,8,10,11,12)
